simple.meaning: טַחֲנָה (ṭachănâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a hand mill ; hence (figuratively) chewing.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Ecclesiastes, beginning at Ecclesiastes 12:4. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to טַחֲנָה (H2913) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: טַחֲנָה (ṭachănâh) / H2913 is traced through Ecclesiastes 12:4 with source-language evidence and verse context.
